pairs.subject: native-shell-integration
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/grants-gov/src/lib.rs:6 The grants apps are headless library crates (`impl ScrapeApp`) that do JSON/HTML fetches and normalisation inside a server binary, with no native wrapper, presentation layer, overlay, input synthesis or OS permission. I searched the five context crates for tauri, webview, always_on_top, target_os, keyboard, electron, set_focus and accessibility and got zero hits; the only 'overlay' hits are `overlay_amounts`, which merges data and has nothing to do with windows. So the subject's precondition (a native process holding capabilities the presentation layer cannot reach) is not met.

techniques.evidence: crates/apps/grants-gov/Cargo.toml:9 Depends only on core, serde_json, chrono and grants-common. There are no platform-specific capabilities and no cfg(target_os) gating.
crates/apps/grants-gov/src/lib.rs:118 A batch scrape job run by the server worker. There is no window or view whose backgrounding could throttle a stream.
